comment: The maturity discussion correctly recognises that early-stage countries may use one committee for strategic and operational governance. However, it does not address safeguards against concentration of authority or conflicts of interest in this transitional arrangement.

anchor.note: p.63 l.Lines 517-528 read as the printed page; section 3.4.7 agrees

public.text: The maturity discussion correctly recognises that early-stage countries may use one committee for strategic and operational governance. However, it does not address safeguards against concentration of authority or conflicts of interest in this transitional arrangement.
public.suggestedRevision: Require role separation within the committee, documented decision categories, conflict-of-interest declarations, independent review for high-risk decisions, transparent records, and a time-bound roadmap toward stronger institutional separation.
